triage_groups.title: Source identity and regression coverage
triage_groups.context: Apply queue: placement freshness and native parity depend on source identity across separate artifacts.
triage_groups.preferred_resolution: Bind current frozen inputs to both manifests (#1, #2), then add discriminating route and pcbnew adapter tests (#3, #6).
triage_groups.why: The tests need to exercise the final source-bound commands after the identity checks are repaired.

triage_groups.title: Insulation verification evidence
triage_groups.context: Decision gate: rule generation and copper evidence determine whether the insulation checks are trustworthy.
triage_groups.preferred_resolution: Settle Rust ownership of the barrier verdict (#5), then exercise the saved rule file through KiCad (#4) and bind copper enumeration to one board snapshot (#7).
triage_groups.why: The end-to-end proof should exercise the chosen authoritative rule path and a stable board snapshot.

learnings.title: Generated-safety netlist-to-PCB parity gate
learnings.note: A route must reject a stale physical board before replay; this history informs findings #1 and #2.

learnings.title: Three silent failures in a measurement pipeline
learnings.note: Fail on KiCad rejection or missing and empty classifications rather than treating them as clean output.

learnings.title: Physical isolation barrier requires domain-first floorplan
learnings.note: A pairwise plan-view copper pass does not establish corridor topology or package-surface insulation.

learnings.title: Netclass-aware clearance single source of truth
learnings.note: Keep placement, routing, generated KiCad rules, and verification on one effective constraint authority.

learnings.title: A ratchet whose inputs are not pinned cannot be ratcheted
learnings.note: Persist rule bytes, KiCad version, and invocation with any later reproducible DRC result; no ratchet was introduced here.

residual_risks: The parity, plan-view barrier, KiCad DRC and stackup checks remain separate commands. A PASS from one is not a complete routed-board acceptance receipt; the caller must enforce the entire ordered gate sequence.

The pad-escape adapter starts cargo run without a subprocess deadline. A blocked shared build lock would leave route replay waiting with a partial output directory; no production hang was established in this review.
testing_gaps: test_barrier_rejects_unsupported_or_missing_copper mutates only an item kind; no added test exercises checked_items' missing-pad census or check()'s absent HOT/barrier-copper rejection.
